user_story:
As a user, I want to see notification messages on the notification messages page so that I can be informed about actions I take.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the user is on the notification messages page, when the user clicks on the link 'Click here', they should see a notification message displayed in the 'flash-messages' div.
2. The URL should remain '/notification_message_rendered' after the action.
3. The footer should display 'Powered by Elemental Selenium' in the 'page-footer' div.
